data.description:
Navigli's Nest - Close to the metro and train offers accommodations in Milan, one mile from MUDEC and 1.5 miles from Palazzo Reale. The property is around 1.5 miles from Museo Del Novecento, 1.5 miles from Santa Maria delle Grazie, and 1.2 miles from San Maurizio al Monastero Maggiore. Free Wifi is available throughout the property and Darsena is a 8-minute walk away.

The spacious apartment includes a fully equipped kitchen with an oven and a microwave, as well as a coffee machine. Towels and bed linen are available in the apartment. The accommodation offers an air conditioning, a heating, and a private bathroom.

Galleria Vittorio Emanuele is 3.4 miles from the apartment, while Duomo Square is 3.4 miles from the property. Milan Linate Airport is 5.6 miles away.
This property does not accommodate bachelor(ette) or similar parties. License number: 015146-CNI-07497, IT015146C24IW2TNV4
